what: field_runner waits before every job until the GPU used memory stays < 2000 MiB for 3 checks 60 s apart; launch_chain.sh runs Field K after Field R on GPU1
why: field_runner only checked for a free GPU once at launch; GPU1 idles for hours during gate_wait and a teammate job could take it, after which our training would co-reside (OOM risk); a separate Field K launcher on GPU1 would start inside that idle window
effect_on_measurement: none: scheduling only; training, evaluation, gates and decision rules unchanged
